other_conditions: Must be registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Madhya Pradesh
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application
Assistance is limited to a maximum of three children
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹16,000 as maternity allowance, paid in two installments of ₹4,000 and ₹12,000.
